text:
lorenzo: Heads up — samplekit sandbox is failing for fncall + JSON_MODE in the JS SDK. Getting a parse error: Unexpected token \" when the auth retry kicks in. Repro below.

lorenzo: ```js
// simplified call
await sdk.callTool({
  tool: 'get_invoice',
  json_mode: true,
  input: { invoiceId: 'abc123' },
  retry: { onAuth: true }
});
```

maria: Ugh. Which SDK version and samplekit branch?

lorenzo: sdk-js v0.14.2, samplekit master (sandbox). Errors show the tool output arrives as a quoted string after the auth refresh: '\"{\"amount\":100}\"' so the JSON parser chokes.

aj: This smells like the retry wrapper double-encoding the JSON payload when it replays the request. We fixed a similar double-encode in the py SDK last month.

sam: Can confirm in Python too — I hit this using samplekit example with JSON_MODE enabled. Steps: 1) hit endpoint, 2) token expired trigger, 3) refresh and retry -> tool output wrapped in extra quotes.

maria: Quick log excerpt: 
```
INFO: retrying request after auth refresh
DEBUG: tool response raw: "\"{\\\"amount\\\":100}\""
ERROR: jsonschema parse error at line 1 column 1
```

ci-bot: ci: samplekit sandbox tests failed (build #1234) — see https://ci.internal/redwood/1234

aj: Proposed mitigation: in retry middleware, detect content that looks like a quoted JSON string and unescape a single layer before passing to the schema validator. But we need to be careful: some tools legitimately return a string that happens to look like JSON. Need a test harness.

lisa: Also a parity problem: JS helper normalizeToolResponse() currently leaves quoted JSON alone, while py helper unescapes. We should pick a single canonical behavior and document it (and add an integration test).

lorenzo: Action items: @aj take the hotfix PR for sdk-js, @maria add an e2e in samplekit/examples/jsonmode-fncall that reproduces the auth-retry case, @sam verify py sdk still behaves after fix. I'll add a docs note about JSON_MODE pitfalls for onboarding.

sam: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/432 with repro steps.

maria: Will add test + minimal repro under examples/jsonmode-fncall and link from the issue.

aj: Opening PR now (will include unit for retry middleware and a changelog entry).

aj: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/987 — please review when you have a sec.

maria: :thumbsup: I can validate the sandbox once it's merged.

lorenzo: Thanks — this is high friction for new users, so good to tighten up before next bootcamp.
